title: Contextual schema repair and developer hints for tool-calls
creator: Julian Park
description: Design and implement a context-aware parameter validation layer for tool/function calls that emits actionable, user-facing repair hints. The validator should combine the declared JSON schema with runtime signals (request provenance, recent user messages, example payloads) to produce prioritized diagnostics and suggested fixes rather than only opaque schema errors. Goal: reduce diagnosis time for engineers and product teams by providing a single diagnostic that includes (1) human-readable error, (2) concrete minimal mutation examples, and (3) confidence/conflict metadata for downstream routing and telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime validator integrates with call-routing: rejects invalid requests and returns structured error envelope with a human_hint + minimal_fix_examples + telemetry_tag

At least three common mismatch classes must have automated fix suggestions: missing required field (with inferred default), wrong primitive type (with coercion example), enum mismatch (with closest option suggestion)
Validator emits a "compatibility_fingerprint" to allow fallback routing to compatible model variants and logs to the schema-compat dashboard
E2E integration test demonstrating example-driven repair reduces mean developer iteration time on a sample prompt set by >= 25% (measured on internal harness)
Performance regression: validation adds < 1ms p50 latency on average for typical call payloads and < 5ms p99
technical_notes: We will build on existing schema manifest format but extend with optional "repairHints" metadata that can be generated by model-assisted synthesis during onboarding
Local runtime will support three repair strategies: suggest-only, auto-coerce (configurable per-route), and fallback routing (send to compatible model variant).
Telemetry: each diagnostic must include tags: rule_id, severity, confidence_score (0-1), and provenance (sdk|console|direct-api).
Security: avoid auto-coercion for binary/credential fields. A separate denylist will be enforced at schema authoring time.
decisions: Prefer suggest-only as default behavior; auto-coerce behind explicit route config to prevent silent data mutation.
Include minimal_fix_examples as short JSON snippets (max 3 variants) to keep error payload < 2KB for typical cases.
Expose compatibility_fingerprint as a stable string hashed from a canonicalized schema + semantic hints to enable routing policies in Smart Routing layer.
progress_updates: 2025-02-05 - Julian Park: Drafted RFC and collected initial failure classes from runtime logs (missing-field, type-mismatch, unknown-enum).
2025-02-07 - Maya Chen: Prototype validator that flags type mismatches and returns human_hint created. Proof-of-concept live on local dev cluster.
2025-02-09 - Design review with Priya Patel: UX prefers a concise single-line error + expand for examples. Requested localized message templates.
2025-02-11 - Engineering review: decided to cap suggested examples to 3 and add confidence_score. Added unit tests for coercion edge-cases.
2025-02-12 - Integration test: validator attached to sample product route; p50 validation latency measured at 0.6ms.
risks: Auto-coercion could mutate sensitive payloads — mitigation: denylist & audit log all coercions.
Large schemas could increase CPU cost for canonicalization — mitigation: cache compatibility_fingerprint and use incremental diff for schema updates.
Poorly-worded human_hints could confuse users — mitigation: add localized templates and run pilot with internal SDK teams.
next_steps: Finish schema canonicalizer and fingerprint algorithm (owner: Maya)
Add localized message templates and edge-case wording guidance for PM/Design (owner: Priya)
Ship validator as a feature flag on the dev tier and gather failure/repair telemetry for 2 weeks
Create migration guide for partners who relied on permissive SDK behavior
blockers: Need sign-off from privacy/security on the auto-coercion denylist (assigned to Security)
Locale team to confirm translation pipeline for human_hint strings
qa_plan: Unit tests covering three failure classes + 10 fuzzed payloads per schema
Integration test that asserts fallback routing triggers when compatibility_fingerprint mismatch < threshold
Manual UX smoke tests for message readability across en-US and ja-JP locales
